title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential corridors and student-frequented blocks surrounding Bethel University's Arden Hills campus.

cards.title: Snelling Avenue
cards.subtitle: Arden Hills Corridor
cards.notes: This major artery connects the main campus to essential retail hubs and local dining favorites like Chick-fil-A and local coffee shops.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial corridor providing direct access to campus and nearby suburban amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Snelling Avenue runs through Arden Hills offering a convenient route for businesses and residents near Bethel University.
cards.source_title: Business Districts | Arden Hills, MN - Official Website
cards.access_notes: Open public thoroughfare; primary vehicle access to the university's main entrance.

cards.title: County Road E West
cards.subtitle: Arden Hills Student Hub
cards.notes: Visit the local Dunn Brothers Coffee for study sessions or grab a quick bite at the nearby Chipotle and Five Guys.
cards.short_summary: A key intersection block featuring student-friendly dining and popular off-campus study spots.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunn Brothers Coffee and other dining options like Chipotle are located on County Road E West near Bethel.
cards.source_title: Community Highlights | E Street Flats | Student Living in Arden Hills
cards.access_notes: Public commercial block with various business hours; Dunn Brothers typically open until 7 PM.

cards.title: Lexington Avenue
cards.subtitle: Roseville Dining Block
cards.notes: Stop by Keys Cafe & Bakery for their famous oversized caramel rolls or visit Namaste Indian Grill for a sit-down meal.
cards.short_summary: A popular dining stretch in Roseville frequently visited by students for weekend brunch and international cuisine.
cards.evidence_claim: Keys Cafe & Bakery is a long-standing favorite located at 1682 Lexington Ave N in Roseville.
cards.access_notes: Public street; individual restaurant hours vary, typically closing by 8 PM.

cards.title: Highway 96 West
cards.subtitle: Shoreview Gateway
cards.notes: Access the scenic Snail Lake Regional Park or grab a meal at Shore 96, a local favorite for pizza and burgers.
cards.short_summary: The northern gateway corridor connecting the campus to Shoreview's parks and local eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: Shore 96 is located at 1056 Highway 96 West and is noted as a family-friendly local spot.
cards.source_title: Shore 96 | Family-Friendly Restaurant & Bar in Shoreview
cards.access_notes: Public highway corridor; Shore 96 is open late on weekends until 12 AM.

cards.title: Rice Street
cards.subtitle: Little Canada Corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Little Venetian for classic Italian fare or stop by the local Culver's for a quick student-friendly meal.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial street in Little Canada offering a mix of traditional restaurants and fast-casual options.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice Street in Little Canada features local landmarks like the Little Venetian and various retail services.
cards.source_title: Resource Directory • Little Canada, MN • CivicEngage
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; businesses generally open daily with standard retail hours.

cards.title: County Road F West
cards.subtitle: Arden Hills Residential Block
cards.notes: This block is home to several off-campus student apartment complexes like Arden Flats, providing a short commute to campus.
cards.short_summary: A primary residential corridor for Bethel students living just off-campus in Arden Hills.
cards.evidence_claim: Arden Flats is located at 1290 County Road F W, serving as a major off-campus housing site for Bethel students.
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; apartment access limited to residents and guests.

cards.title: Larpenteur Avenue
cards.subtitle: Falcon Heights Hub
cards.notes: Explore the area near the Minnesota State Fairgrounds or grab a late-night slice at Toppers Pizza.
cards.short_summary: A bustling avenue in Falcon Heights known for its proximity to the State Fair and student-friendly pizza spots.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers Pizza is located at 1539 Larpenteur Avenue West in Falcon Heights and offers late-night service.
cards.source_title: Falcon Heights MN Restaurant - Toppers Pizza
cards.access_notes: Public street; Toppers Pizza is open until 3 AM on Fridays and Saturdays for late-night needs.

cards.title: Cleveland Avenue
cards.subtitle: Roseville Retail Block
cards.notes: Navigate this corridor to reach the Rosedale Center area or stop by local service businesses and specialty shops.
cards.short_summary: A major north-south corridor in Roseville providing access to the region's largest shopping mall.
cards.evidence_claim: Cleveland Avenue is a primary route through Roseville's commercial and retail districts near Bethel.
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; connects to major shopping centers with varying hours.

cards.title: Victoria Street
cards.subtitle: Shoreview Civic Block
cards.notes: Visit the Shoreview Community Center for recreation or the nearby Tropics Indoor Waterpark for a winter escape.
cards.short_summary: The civic heart of Shoreview, featuring major recreational facilities used by the local community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shoreview Community Center is located at 4580 Victoria St N and serves as a major local recreation hub.
cards.access_notes: Public street; Community Center hours vary by season, typically open until 9 PM.

cards.title: Pine Tree Drive
cards.subtitle: Anderson Center Corridor
cards.notes: This block connects the main campus to Bethel's Anderson Center and the new Lake Johanna Fire Department headquarters.
cards.short_summary: A critical link between Bethel's primary campus and its satellite academic and administrative facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Anderson Center is located at 2 Pine Tree Drive, serving as a secondary campus hub for Bethel University.
cards.access_notes: Public road; Anderson Center access typically requires a Bethel ID for certain areas.
